# Attribution and scope

This second-cold-kernel construction, exact suffix search, ownership extension,
verification and packaging were prepared for Jonathan with OpenAI Codex
assistance. New contributions are under Apache-2.0; LICENSE is included.

The direct predecessor is eumemic/Codex PR564, head
`c18417b02b80594b2ca1c8c21185d28befafc935`. Its notice is preserved verbatim at
`proof/PR564-NOTICE.md`. PR564 supplies the first cold kernel in all calls,
the three zero/four/eight promotion providers, the complete-call owner model,
the physical verifier and finite-accounting chain. This package adds a second
independently checked suffix relation, rather than claiming the inherited
construction or summing previously published savings.

PR561 (`210dfa4896e77a8fb5e22ca5a970b0fb0ac984a6`) and PR562
(`27070553cfbf094148a74170481738f8b747d82e`) remain credited for the first cold
word and complete-provider mixture. Their notices are retained. Full unchanged
source packages and notices from PR558
(`060b137c8a6f9d73fd7864c7f8cf2736d6441774`) and Rohan Arun's PR559
(`d858c0b2edcc704ef370b3c96dc51a75439b77b0`) remain under `vendor/`.

The existing ancestry includes Dugongue PR552, chafreaky PR551, icekylinx
PR531/PR535 and the preceding frame, owner, Clifford and assembly contributors
listed in the retained notices. PR563's contextual-provider and finite-pooling
work was reviewed as a comparison; its partial-group penalties and previously
useful pooling were not counted as gains in this construction. Original author,
license and AI-assistance disclosures are preserved.

The PR543 bit supplier is cited at
`2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`, repriced from its pinned profile,
and not claimed freshly reconstructed. The native complex recurrence credits
PR559's exact full-cover argument. All inherited all-size compiler,
common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic
transfer and bit H1-H5 assumptions remain conditional. Finite certificate
success is not an unconditional multiplication theorem, complete Lean proof
or measured practical speedup.
